As a PhD candidate, you’ll study advanced topics across the fields of systems, theory and applications. You’ll graduate with a diverse, encompassing knowledge of computer science with an edge in establishing a career in any field.
Expected length
Project or thesis
Course-based
4 years
Yes
No
Quick facts
Program options:
Doctorate
Study options:
Full-time study
Program delivery:
On-campus
Dynamic learning:
Co-op optional
Outcomes
Students in this program will:
perform independent research and teach university courses in computer science
lead a research team in an industrial or academic setting
acquire advanced Computer science, engineering and complementary interdisciplinary skills
gain academic research and/or industrial experience in computer science
respect security, privacy, and diversity of end-users in problem-solving and decision-making in the information technology (IT) industry
learn the role, ethics and responsibilities of computer scientists
Find a supervisor
Computer Science PhD applicants don’t need a supervisor to apply for admission.
However, you should list potential supervisors in your application. Supervisors make the final decisions on admission for eligible applicants.
